preconditions: The deepest displayed unit is already authorized by the selected synthetic regional/domain profile.
The drawing frame extends below the calculated model boundary only because of drafting-scale rounding.
No observed basal contact, fault, intrusion, or unconformity requires a different unit in that interval.
decisionLogic: Continue the existing deepest displayed unit to the rounded drawing-frame lower edge.
Reuse the same unit identifier, normalized lithology label, colour and hatch layer.
Classify the added polygon as SyntheticBasalContinuation with basisType SyntheticAssumption.
Never invent a new basement lithology solely to fill drawing space.
outputs: A gap-free section polygon partition to the drawing frame.
A visible note that the continuation is not an observation.
uncertainty: The continuation is a conventional stratigraphic continuity prior, not evidence of the unique subsurface truth.
exclusions: Observed or literature-supported changes below the model boundary
Cross-cutting structures that invalidate vertical continuation
validationMethod: The continuation unitId equals continuationOfUnitId and the existing deepest unitId.
Its upper vertices exactly equal the calculated lower model boundary.
Its lower vertices exactly equal the rounded drawing-frame lower elevation.
All coloured hatch layer names contain a sanitized normalized lithology suffix.
reopenCondition: Reopen when route-applicable subsurface evidence defines a different deeper unit or basal contact.
